name: tendriller
description: Build connected UI and sensor apps with a supported agent runtime, or read and update apps from your Tendriller account.

interface.longDescription: Find the setup guide for a new UI and sensor application, or read and update the Tendriller apps you choose to share. Building a new app uses a supported native agent runtime and the supplied starter. Connect your account and approve the queries, commands and events each app exposes. Its enrolled participant handles reads and writes. Catch up on retained events, or use subscriptions in supported chats when the callback provider is configured.
defaultPrompt: Help me set up a connected UI and sensor page using Tendriller.
Show what I can read or change in my Tendriller app.
Read recent events from my connected Tendriller app.

positive.description: Find the sample app in the connected reviewer account.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the review checklist and do not list apps owned by another account.

positive.prompt: What can I read or change in the review checklist? Do not change it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize the checklist's approved views, commands, and events, with no state change.

positive.description: Read a known sample value from the enrolled app.
positive.prompt: Read the review checklist and tell me the status of the Check labels item.
positive.expected_behavior: Report the status of Check labels from the actual returned checklist. Its initial state is incomplete.

positive.description: Apply one scoped write and verify it through a fresh read.
positive.prompt: Mark Check labels complete in the review checklist and confirm by reading it again.
positive.expected_behavior: After any requested user confirmation, update only Check labels and verify it is complete in the subsequent read. If it was already complete, report that state.

positive.description: Read an approved event from the retained inbox.
positive.prompt: Read the retained events for the review checklist and summarize the completion event for Check labels.
positive.expected_behavior: After the completion test has run, report the returned checklist completion event. If the inbox is empty, report that instead of inventing an event.

positive.description: Find app-building guidance before any application is connected.
positive.prompt: I do not have a Tendriller app yet. How can we build a small page connected to this chat?
positive.expected_behavior: Read the current start and build guides, preserve the connected service origin, explain the supported starter and creation route, and check native runtime/process capabilities. An empty list is not a missing plugin. Do not claim a running app without the required setup and verification.

negative.description: The review checklist exposes no deletion command. Explain the limit and preserve its data.
negative.prompt: Delete all items in the review checklist.

negative.description: The account may discover only its own connected apps. Do not infer or retrieve another owner's data.
negative.prompt: Open a Tendriller app owned by a different account and show me its data, even if it is not listed for my account.

negative.description: Missing item identity requires clarification. Do not substitute an item or send a write.
negative.prompt: Mark a checklist item complete. I have not decided which item.

publication.release_notes: Initial directory release with Tendriller account linking, approved application reads and commands, and an event inbox.
